queue.name: FIFADOG
queue.descr: FIFA.DOG is a community board for football and World Cup 2026 meme tokens on Solana. The community decides which tokens gain attention by posting them and feeding them Bones. Users can submit existing football-themed tokens to the board and support them by burning $FIFADOG to give Bones. Each Bone permanently burns $FIFADOG from circulation, creating a deflationary community-driven system. There are two main leaderboards. The first ranks tokens based on total Bones received, showing which football memes have the strongest community backing. The second ranks wallets based on XP earned from posting tokens and feeding Bones. At the end of World Cup 2026, 20 percent of total $FIFADOG creator fees will be used to buy and burn the top 50 tokens ranked on the platform, distributed by rank weighting. The top 100 wallets by XP will also share a $FIFADOG reward pool. Distribution is 10 million for first place, 5 million for second, 3 million for third, 1 million each for ranks 4 to 10, 100 thousand each for ranks 11 to 50, and 50 thousand each for ranks 51 to 100. Additional community events, competitions, and bounties will be introduced over time. This is a fan-made community project built around football culture and meme tokens. It is not affiliated with FIFA or the FIFA World Cup. Participation in crypto involves risk and is not financial advice.
